description: Enlarges the area where each Breach Light fully exposes patterns.
Makes each Breach Light sweep faster.
Deploys more LYNE drones per cast, each able to bring back a fish.
Deploys more Breach Lights at the same time.
Makes rarer species more likely to appear among new buried patterns.
Keeps patterns exposed and within reach longer after a Breach Light passes over them.
Detects buried patterns as dents farther from each lamp's aim point without fully exposing them.
Slows surfaced patterns more while they are inside a Breach Light beam.
Makes LYNE drones turn and change speed faster.
Expands the visible fishing ring and the drones' base search reach.
Lets drones chase a pattern longer before returning to the fishing ring.
Lets drones spot and pursue patterns farther beyond the fishing ring.
Makes idle drones more likely to choose the rarest pattern within reach.
Increases the number of harpoon shots you can keep ready.
Lets the head catch patterns it narrowly misses.
